note: Benchmark fixtures isolate downstream context fidelity. Real-derived cards are normalized from accepted PDDR decisions; synthetic siblings are explicit counterfactual fixtures and are not historical project claims. Provenance metadata is never rendered into model prompts.

cards.decision: Use one Python-standard-library CLI for initialization and validation, reuse that CLI in CI, and accept a deliberately narrow metadata grammar for v0.1.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes zero extra runtime dependencies and one portable local/CI path over full YAML expressiveness.

cards.decision: Use one Python CLI backed by a reviewed external YAML package for initialization and validation, and reuse the same CLI in CI.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes mature YAML semantics and future metadata extensibility over a zero-dependency runtime.

cards.decision: Track only toolkit-managed files in a hash manifest, provide dry-run, and abort all writes when any managed file differs from its recorded hash.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes non-destructive upgrades and explicit human resolution over automatic merging of locally edited managed files.

cards.decision: Perform a best-effort three-way merge for locally edited managed files, continue updating files that merge cleanly, and surface only unresolved conflicts for human review.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes automated upgrade continuity while preserving local edits through merge semantics.

cards.decision: Generate review artifacts only and require a human-reviewed publication change; the generation workflow itself does not commit, push, merge, or replace published files.
cards.rationale: Machine structural checks are useful but are not treated as proof of linguistic or semantic publication quality.

provenance.source_title: Review-only translation artifacts and human publication

cards.decision: Automatically publish generated translations when all configured structural and terminology gates pass.
cards.rationale: The project treats the reviewed machine gates as the publication boundary so routine translations do not require a separate human publication step.

cards.decision: Ship one narrow reviewed provider/model profile with an exact endpoint, explicit request guards, bounded request volume, and documented remaining trust boundaries.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes a reproducible first path and a small trust surface over immediate provider generality.

provenance.source_title: Keep the initial provider profile narrow and enforce runtime request guards

cards.decision: Define a provider-neutral interface first and require provider-specific adapters to normalize transport/model differences behind that contract.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes provider portability and comparable downstream behavior over a single-provider first implementation.

cards.decision: Production callers pin a reviewed immutable commit SHA or reviewed release tag and update that pin explicitly when a new workflow revision is approved.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes reproducibility and reviewed upgrades over silently receiving upstream changes.

provenance.source_title: Keep repository-specific responsibility in the caller and pin reviewed workflow revisions

cards.decision: Production callers track the reusable workflow's main branch so reviewed upstream fixes propagate immediately without per-caller pin updates.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes rapid fix rollout and low consumer maintenance over immutable run-to-run workflow identity.

cards.decision: Freeze backend expansion once methodologically distinct comparison arms are covered, and add another backend only when it fills an explicit research gap.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes dataset depth, failure analysis, and downstream evaluation over collecting every newly discovered backend.

provenance.source_title: Freeze backend expansion after methodologically distinct coverage

cards.decision: Add every credible newly discovered backend to the shared comparison matrix so landscape coverage remains as complete as practical.
cards.rationale: The project prioritizes breadth of backend coverage and current ecosystem representation over limiting comparison-arm growth.
